## Technical focus
React, Next.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, REST APIs, JWT authentication, role-based access, Firebase Firestore, Python, Laravel, and UI/UX implementation.

## Selected work
- CrystalStonesMart: independent commercial MERN e-commerce build with catalog, cart, Google OAuth, orders, and analytics portal.
- Nutrition Mate: React and Firebase Firestore application with BMI calculation and calorie planning.
- CoderKube Technology: MERN developer work on client and in-house applications, including JD Web and Ship.

Project scope, pricing, remote arrangements, and joining availability are discussed directly with Ammar.

## Services and collaboration
Ammar develops responsive web interfaces, connected MERN applications, backend APIs, and e-commerce workflows. Ongoing work can include features, bug fixes, and third-party API integrations. Clients can email a project brief with requirements, integrations, and a target timeline to discuss an estimate.

## Developer roles
Ammar is interested in full-stack, MERN, and React/Node.js developer opportunities, including remote roles and contract work. Recruiters can send a job description, stack, working arrangement, and interview process. A resume and additional project context can be requested by email.
